parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
